title: Letter & Memo Re Inquiry On J.W.F. Cameron

page_data.en:
S.B. D.1457
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL
C. & S. D. RECS.
No. S. B. D. 1457.
date 25 - 7 - 30.）

July 24, 30.

Dear Mr. North,

With reference to your memo of July 19, 1930,
I have to inform you that John William Fraser Cameron
was in 1928 residing in Korea, where he was engaged
in coal mining. He returned to Shanghai at the end
of that year and borrowed ¥700 from his wife on the
understanding that he would return to England. This
he promised to do, but instead proceeded to Harbin
where he again borrowed money to enable him to
reach England.

So far as can be ascertained, his latest
address is c/o The Regent Palace Hotel, Piccadilly
Circus, London W.

Yours sincerely,

P.A. North Esq.,
H.B.M. Consulate-General,
Shanghai.

（手写批注：Mc）

日期 30年7月25日。）

1930年7月24日。

尊敬的诺斯先生：

关于您1930年7月19日的备忘录，
兹告知，约翰·威廉·弗雷泽·卡梅伦
于1928年居住在朝鲜，当时从事
煤矿开采工作。他在该年年底
返回上海，并向其妻子借款700元，
约定他将返回英国。他虽承诺如此，
但却前往哈尔滨，在那里再次借款以
便能够抵达英国。

据查，他最近的地址为：伦敦西区
皮卡迪利广场摄政宫酒店转交。

此致
敬礼，

P.A. 诺斯 先生，
英国驻上海总领事馆，
上海。

（手写批注：Mc）

REPORT
Date July 23, 1930.
Subject (in full) J.W.F. Cameron.
Made by D.P.S. Moore. Forwarded by [签名]
Sir,
Reference the attached enquiry from the British
Consulate Passport Office.
John William Fraser Cameron was in 1928, residing
in Korea where he was engaged in coal mining. He
returned to Shanghai at the end of that year and
borrowed $700 from his wife (from whom he had been legally
separated for some years on account of his drunken
habits), on the understanding that he would return to
England. This he promised to do, but instead, went to
Harbin where he borrowed more money to enable him to
reach England.
So far as can be ascertained his latest address
is as follows, c/o The Regent Palace Hotel, Piccadilly
Circus, London W.
W. Moore
(D. P. S.
D. C.
(C. & S. Branches)
（批：Reg. Please prepare reply to Mr North giving the information bearing on Cameron's movements included in the above report.
[签名]

MEMORANDUM.

From Passport Office,
BRITISH CONSULATE-GENERAL
SHANGHAI 19th July, 1930.

To
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL C. & S. B. REGS. No. S. B. D. 1457. date 21 - 7 - 30.）
R.C. Aiers, Esquire,
Shanghai Municipal Police.

Dear Mr Aiers,

An enquiry has been received from the Legation regarding one J.W. Cameron who was in Peking about 1925, afterwards clearing out without paying his Club bill, etc. It is understood that he is now in Shanghai, and it is desired to get into touch with him in connection with a loan of $550 which is still outstanding.

There is no record of Cameron in this office and I should therefore be grateful if you would let me know whether you have any trace of him.

Yours sincerely,
（签名）

备忘录。

发自护照办公室，
英国驻上海总领事馆
上海 1930年7月19日。

致
（印：上海工部局 C. & S. B. 登记处。编号 S. B. D. 1457. 日期 30年7月21日。）
R.C. 艾尔斯 先生，
上海公共租界工部局警务处。

尊敬的艾尔斯先生：

本公使馆收到一项查询，涉及一名 J.W. 卡梅伦，此人约在1925年身处北平，随后未支付其俱乐部账单等费用便潜逃。据悉他目前在上海，现希望与其取得联系，因其仍有一笔550元的贷款尚未偿还。

本处并无卡梅伦的记录，因此，若您能告知是否掌握其任何踪迹，我将不胜感激。

此致
敬礼，
（签名）
